title: Polynomial-time suffix truncation
statement: For all natural numbers $a$ and $k$, the following function on bit strings is polynomial-time computable: decode the input into components $x$ and $y$, using empty components when decoding fails, and return the encoding of $x$ paired with the suffix of $y$ obtained by dropping its first $a(|x|+1)^k$ bits.
